card.name: Literary prose, commas before speech tags
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words in older literary or narrative prose, such as a comma closing a quoted remark before 'said', or verbs and nouns like 'promise', 'existence', 'suggesting' in descriptive passages.

modes.label: Comma ending quoted speech
modes.description: A comma or quote mark closing a spoken line, just before a speech tag like 'said'.

modes.label: Word inside a descriptive clause
modes.description: A noun or participle in a formal description of a person or work, followed by 'of' or a object phrase.
